block.mega_asr.workflow: Transcribe completed recordings locally. Prepare the model separately; Run never downloads weights.
block.mega_asr.apply_hint: Changes remain local until Apply. Restart a loaded Run to use new settings.
block.mega_asr.invalid_number: Check the numeric value and its limits.
block.mega_asr.model.title: MEGA ASR
block.mega_asr.model.description: Transcribe completed recordings with the local pinned MEGA-ASR model and acoustic router.
block.mega_asr.help_asset_directory: Prepare the pinned 4.8 GB assets with setup_model.py first. No download occurs during a Run.
block.mega_asr.help_environment_python: Dedicated environment containing requirements.txt. Empty uses the application's interpreter; never installed automatically.
block.mega_asr.help_allowed_root: Completed input files must stay inside this directory. Empty uses the application root.
block.mega_asr.help_device: CPU or the first CUDA device. Unavailable CUDA fails explicitly; no silent CPU fallback.
block.mega_asr.help_language: Automatic detection or an explicit training language. No word timestamps or diarization are produced.
block.mega_asr.help_context: Optional context for the transcription, up to 4 KiB. It is not a command or a post-transcription agent instruction.
block.mega_asr.help_routing: Automatic routes each chunk through the base or adapted model. Always MEGA forces the official LoRA adapter.
block.mega_asr.help_quality_threshold: Router probability threshold for applying the MEGA adapter. Not transcription confidence.
block.mega_asr.help_precision: Float32 for CPU compatibility; bfloat16 reduces model memory but depends on the device.
block.mega_asr.help_threads: Bound CPU parallelism in the owned inference process.
block.mega_asr.help_chunk_duration_sec: Longer recordings are split into contiguous chunks. Boundaries may split words; these are input spans, not word timestamps.
block.mega_asr.help_max_duration_sec: Refuse longer files instead of silently truncating them. Default: five minutes.
block.mega_asr.help_max_file_bytes: Bound the completed source before conversion. Default: 64 MiB.
block.mega_asr.help_max_new_tokens: A missing end-of-sequence fails the whole request instead of publishing an incomplete transcript.
block.mega_asr.help_timeout_sec: Includes conversion, checksum verification, loading and every chunk. CPU inference can be slow.
block.mega_asr.help_memory_limit_mib: Linux virtual-memory ceiling, not a reservation or GPU-memory guarantee. Loading fails if insufficient.
